brief: A 30-second birthday video from 12 phone clips and a song.
requirements: the footage is the 12 named phone clips (count 12: all twelve ingested as inputs; the montage is cut from them)
the named song is the music bed (the one track the brief names — the piece is built on it)
the bed is mixed, not pasted: ducked 10-14 dB under any clip speech, one mix at the loudness target (LUFS ±1, true peak <= -1 dBTP)
the montage is paced to the song (cuts land on the beat; 12 clips across 30s implies ~2.5s average per clip — no long holds)
it reads as a birthday video (a celebratory arc and a birthday title or closing moment; subjective — critic evidence)
no format was named: the plan states its assumption (phone clips suggest 9:16 vertical; whichever it picks is written down)
the 12 phone clips are missing: flagged in feasibility — never fabricated (no stand-in stock clips passed off as the human's)
the song is missing: flagged in feasibility — never replaced by a synthesized or stock track passed off as the named song
one piece, one mix (the song bed and any clip audio land as a single mix, not stitched per clip)
must_not: inventing the 12 phone clips or the song (both missing: flagged in feasibility, never fabricated or replaced by stock media)
motion or math as the base technique (the clips are real footage: only edit cuts a montage; motion may only add a title/end card)
planning fewer than the 12 named clips (the count is an ask: twelve ingested inputs)
a montage with no music bed (the song is named in the brief: the mix is built on it, ducked under any speech)
ignoring the pacing (12 clips in 30 seconds: unpaced long holds are not a montage — cut to the song)
